home.heroTitle: A dental practice with a passion for smiles
home.heroText: Comprehensive treatment in Warsaw — function and aesthetics based on current knowledge and Digital Smile Design. Prevention is our first step towards a calm, lasting smile.
home.careLead: We look at oral health as a whole. The treatment plan considers teeth and gums, bite function and smile aesthetics. In more complex cases it is created together by doctors from different fields.
services: diagnosis and treatment of temporomandibular joint disorders
home.careNote: Every plan is based on an examination and the required photographic and digital records. Before treatment starts we discuss its stages, possible options and costs with the patient.
home.whyTitle: Treatment without stress, with an individual plan
home.h1Text: A treatment plan aligned with the FACE philosophy and Digital Smile Design — from photographic records to the final result.
home.h2Text: Dr Marcin Mazik is a member of the Polish Academy of Aesthetic Dentistry and continually develops his skills in Poland and abroad.
home.h3Text: We take care of painless, calm visits — including for the youngest patients and people with dental anxiety.
home.h4Text: A clean mouth is a better starting point for FACE and DSD plans — less inflammation, a clearer view of the tissues and a more durable aesthetic result.
home.prevLead: It is regular care for teeth and gums: a thorough clean in the practice plus advice tailored to your habits. It helps slow cavities and gum inflammation, and it freshens the look of the smile — including when we plan treatment with FACE and Digital Smile Design.
home.prevPackLead: One visit brings together four stages. Together they leave a smooth, clean tooth surface and a calmer start if further treatment is needed later.

prevSteps.title: Scaling
prevSteps.text: Ultrasound lifts hardened deposits from places a toothbrush cannot reach. Under that layer, bacteria more easily damage enamel and the gum attachment.

prevSteps.title: Air polishing
prevSteps.text: A fine powder with water under pressure lifts soft deposits and stains. The surface becomes more even and easier to keep clean.

prevSteps.title: Fluoride
prevSteps.text: We apply a fluoride gel, foam or varnish to the cleaned enamel to strengthen it and make cavities harder to form.

prevSteps.title: Hygiene coaching
prevSteps.text: The hygienist shows brushing, floss and rinse technique and suggests which food habits best support your teeth.

home.prevGainsTitle: What do you gain from regular prevention?
prevGains: Thorough removal of tartar and deposits from hard-to-reach surfaces
A brighter, smoother smile — without a dull film on the enamel
Fewer bacteria that feed gum inflammation and bad breath
Better conditions for restorative, aesthetic treatment and DSD plans
A clear, personal routine for looking after your mouth between visits
home.prevWhyTitle: A toothbrush at home cannot replace a prevention visit
home.prevWhyText: Daily brushing and flossing are essential, but they do not fully remove mineralising deposits along the gum line and between teeth. Regular prevention closes that gap: it protects the tissues, keeps the aesthetic result and settles the mouth before we move to more complex stages of the treatment plan.

about.title: A practice with a passion for precision and aesthetics
about.lead: Welcome to dentalpassion — a place where an individual treatment plan combines function with a beautiful smile.
about.name: Marcin Mazik
about.spec: Prosthodontics and comprehensive bite reconstruction · aesthetic dentistry · diagnosis and treatment of TMJ disorders
about.p1: Founder of dentalpassion. He focuses on comprehensive bite reconstructions, prosthetic treatment — including implant-supported work — and diagnosis and treatment of TMJ disorders. His work combines proper function, natural aesthetics and digital treatment planning.
about.p2: For years he has been developing his knowledge of occlusion, TMD, prosthodontics and restorative dentistry. He has trained on numerous courses and programmes in Poland and abroad, including FACE, OBI, Dawson, Kois, Bumann and Rocabado. He is a member of the Polish Academy of Aesthetic Dentistry (PASE) and a lecturer who trains fellow dentists.
